newsitem.title: USA: VISA, MasterCard may face Justice Dept suit - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: VISA, MasterCard may face Justice Dept suit - WSJ.

text.p: The Justice Department is preparing to file an antitrust suit against VISA USA and MasterCard International for barring member banks from issuing American Express and Discover cards, the Wall Street Journal said Friday.

The paper, citing people close to the matter, said the Justice Department is expected to recommend filing the suit as early as the end of this month unless VISA and MasterCard agree to change their rules.
The report said the department has scheduled a February 27 meeting between its senior officials and representatives of the credit-card associations to find ways to solve the matter.

Justice officials have been investigating the credit card industry since June, spurred by American Express' complaints over VISA's policy of preventing banks that issue VISA cards from offering competing credit card brands.
Friday's report said VISA and MasterCard are expected to fight a Justice Department challenge.
